title: Slug-flow-based continuous manufacturing of Fe-substituted Ni-rich NCM cathodes for lithium-ion batteries: synthesis and modeling
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,1267-1278
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00032G, Paper
